summary: ACC finalization record (Issue #14): adds status finalizing, draft provenance (letter_draft_review_at / letter_draft_saved_at), finalizing_started_at and finalization_id on acc_decisions; creates the append-only acc_finalizations table (exact letter/packet/documents/email with sha256s; corrections are new versions); and a guard trigger that makes a finalized case (finalization_id set) write-once and undeletable, allowing only decided -> archived/withdrawn. No rows written; cases decided before this migration are unaffected.

preflight.name: acc_finalizations does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'acc_finalizations'

preflight.name: acc_decisions has no finalization_id yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'acc_decisions' AND column_name IN ('finalization_id','letter_draft_review_at','letter_draft_saved_at','finalizing_started_at')

expected_changes: Replaces acc_decisions_status_check to also allow finalizing.
Adds acc_decisions.letter_draft_review_at, letter_draft_saved_at, finalizing_started_at (timestamptz) and finalization_id (uuid), all nullable.
Creates acc_finalizations (append-only via trigger trg_acc_finalizations_append_only + SELECT/INSERT-only grants) with version-chain and email/delivery CHECKs and two indexes.

Creates function acc_decisions_finalized_guard() + trigger trg_acc_decisions_finalized_guard (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE): a finalized case is write-once and undeletable; status may only go decided -> archived/withdrawn.

verify.name: no case is finalizing or linked to a finalization
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM acc_decisions WHERE status = 'finalizing' OR finalization_id IS NOT NULL

verify.name: guard trigger present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_acc_decisions_finalized_guard'
